about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Biscotti
recipes.summary: Twice-baked cocoa biscotti with whole hazelnuts and chocolate chips, made for dunking.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Mix the flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder, then stir in the eggs and vanilla to a stiff dough and fold in the hazelnuts and chocolate chips.
Shape into two logs 25cm long and 6cm wide and bake for 30 minutes, until firm to the touch.
Cool for 10 minutes, then slice each log into 12 pieces on an angle with a serrated knife.
Lay the slices cut side down, lower the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and bake for 12 minutes more, until dry and crisp. Cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten, milk, egg and soy. Per serving: 2 biscotti. Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Pistachio and Sultana Biscotti
recipes.summary: Orange-scented biscotti with green pistachios and plump sultanas, baked twice until crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder, then stir in the eggs, oil and zest to a stiff dough and fold in the pistachios and sultanas.
Shape into two logs 25cm long and 6cm wide and bake for 28 minutes, until golden and firm.
Cool for 10 minutes, then slice each log into 12 pieces on an angle.
Lay the slices cut side down and bake at 150°C fan (170°C conventional) for 12 minutes, until dry and lightly golden. Cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten and egg. Per serving: 2 biscotti. Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Orange and Fennel Seed Biscotti
recipes.summary: A nut-free biscotti with orange zest and toasted fennel seeds, lovely with tea or coffee.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, orange zest and fennel seeds, then stir in the eggs and oil to a stiff dough.
Shape into two logs 25cm long and 5cm wide and bake for 26 minutes, until golden and firm.
Cool for 10 minutes, then slice each log into 12 pieces on an angle.
Lay the slices cut side down and bake at 150°C fan (170°C conventional) for 12 minutes, until dry and crisp. Cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Nut-free. Per serving: 2 biscotti. Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Scottish Shortbread Wedges
recipes.summary: Buttery, crumbly shortbread pressed into a round, pricked and baked slowly until pale gold.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and line a 23cm round tin. Beat the butter and sugar together until creamy.
Work in the flour and salt with your hands until a smooth dough forms, then press into the tin and prick all over with a fork.
Mark into 12 wedges and bake for 40 minutes, until pale golden at the edges.
Re-cut along the lines while hot and cool in the tin before removing.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 wedge. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Lemon Shortbread Rounds
recipes.summary: Tender icing sugar shortbread rounds with lemon zest, crisp at the edges.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter, icing sugar and lemon zest together until pale and creamy.
Mix in the flour and lemon juice until a soft dough forms, then roll into 20 balls and flatten slightly.
Bake for 15 minutes, until barely coloured on top and golden underneath.
Cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 rounds. Keeps 10 days in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Nankhatai Cardamom Biscuits
recipes.summary: Crumbly North Indian ghee biscuits with chickpea flour, semolina and cardamom, topped with pistachio.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Whisk the ghee and icing sugar for 3 minutes until pale and fluffy.
Mix in the flour, besan, semolina, cardamom and baking powder until a soft dough forms.
Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly, press a little pistachio on top and bake for 18 minutes, until set and pale golden.
Cool on the tray, as they firm up when cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten and milk. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Italian Almond Amaretti
recipes.summary: Chewy gluten-free almond macaroons with crisp cracked tops.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays. Whisk the egg whites until foamy, then stir in the almond meal, caster sugar and almond extract to a sticky dough.
Roll into 16 balls, roll each in the icing sugar and place on the trays.
Bake for 18 minutes, until lightly golden and cracked on top.
Cool on the trays, as they firm up when cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Gluten-free (check labels). Contains tree nuts and egg. Per serving: 2 amaretti. Keeps 1 week in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Sables Bretons Butter Biscuits
recipes.summary: Rich Breton butter biscuits made with egg yolks and salted butter, baked in rings for a tall, crumbly texture.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C fan (190°C conventional) and grease 16 holes of a muffin or tartlet tin. Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg yolks one at a time.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until a soft dough forms, then press the dough 1.5cm thick into the greased holes.
Bake for 15 minutes, until deep golden at the edges.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then ease out and cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 1 week in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Speculoos Spiced Biscuits
recipes.summary: Thin caramel-spiced biscuits with cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and cloves, crisp enough for coffee.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C fan (190°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter, sugar and honey together until creamy, then mix in the milk.
Stir in the flour, spices and baking powder to a firm dough, then roll to 4mm thick between two sheets of baking paper.
Cut into 24 rectangles, place on the trays and bake for 12 minutes, until golden brown at the edges.
Cool on the trays, as they crisp up when cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Pepparkakor Swedish Ginger Thins
recipes.summary: Very thin, snappy Swedish ginger biscuits with cinnamon and cloves.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter, sugar and syrup together until creamy, then mix in the milk.
Stir in the flour, spices and bicarbonate of soda to a firm dough, then roll very thinly, about 2mm, between sheets of baking paper.
Cut out 40 shapes, place on the trays and bake for 7 minutes, until crisp and a shade darker at the edges.
Cool on the trays, as they crisp up when cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 4 thins. Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Spritz Butter Cookies
recipes.summary: Piped vanilla butter cookies in ridged ribbons, tender and crisp-edged.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C fan (190°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour and salt to a soft dough and pipe 30 small ribbons or rosettes onto the trays with a star nozzle.
Bake for 12 minutes, until pale gold at the edges.
Cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 3 cookies. Keeps 10 days in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Moroccan Ghriba Coconut Biscuits
recipes.summary: Soft, chewy coconut biscuits with a crackled top, lightly scented with lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Mix the coconut, sugar, semolina, vanilla and lemon zest, then stir in the egg whites until the mixture clumps together.
Roll into 16 small balls and place on the tray.
Bake for 15 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges and cracked on top.
Cool on the tray, as they firm up when cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains gluten (semolina) and egg. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 1 week in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Un Kurabiyesi Turkish Flour Biscuits
recipes.summary: Melt-in-the-mouth Turkish butter biscuits with a dusting of icing sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Beat the butter and icing sugar until pale and creamy, then beat in the egg yolk and vanilla.
Mix in the flour to a soft dough, then roll into 20 balls and press an indent in each with your thumb.
Bake for 20 minutes, until set and barely coloured.
Cool on the tray, as they are fragile while warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 10 days in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Nan-e Nokhodchi Persian Chickpea Flour Biscuits
recipes.summary: Delicate gluten-free Persian chickpea flour biscuits scented with cardamom and topped with pistachio.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and line two trays. Toast the besan in a dry pan over low heat for 5 minutes, until it smells nutty, then cool.
Mix the besan, icing sugar and cardamom, then stir in the melted butter to a soft dough.
Roll into 24 balls, flatten gently and top with pistachio.
Bake for 18 minutes, until set and barely coloured. Cool on the trays, as they are fragile while warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts and milk. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 10 days in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Swedish Dream Biscuits
recipes.summary: Drommar: pale, tender butter biscuits with vanilla that dissolve on the tongue.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, then beat in the vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt to a soft dough, then roll into 24 balls and place on the trays.
Bake for 18 minutes, until set and barely coloured.
Cool on the trays, as they are fragile while warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 biscuits. Keeps 10 days in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Vanillekipferl Almond Crescents
recipes.summary: Austrian crescent biscuits with almond meal and vanilla icing sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays. Rub the butter into the flour, almond meal and 70g of the icing sugar, then mix in the yolk and vanilla to a smooth dough.
Roll pieces into 30 small logs and curve each into a crescent.
Bake for 12 minutes, until pale gold at the edges.
Dust with the remaining icing sugar while still warm, then cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten, egg and milk. Per serving: 3 crescents. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.
Food safety: the eggs are cooked through in the bake; do not taste the raw dough.

recipes.title: Baci di Dama Hazelnut Sandwich Biscuits
recipes.summary: Little hazelnut shortbread domes sandwiched with dark chocolate, the Italian lady's kisses.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then mix in the ground hazelnuts and flour to a dough.
Roll into 40 small balls and bake for 18 minutes, until pale golden. Cool on the trays.
Spread a little melted chocolate on the flat side of 20 biscuits and sandwich with the rest.
Leave to set until the chocolate is firm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten, milk and soy. Per serving: 2 sandwiched biscuits. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
recipes.summary: Walnut shortbread balls rolled in icing sugar, tender and crumbly.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C fan (190°C conventional) and line two trays. Beat the butter and 80g icing sugar until pale and fluffy, then beat in the vanilla.
Mix in the flour, salt and walnuts to a soft dough, then roll into 24 balls and place on the trays.
Bake for 15 minutes, until pale golden underneath.
Roll the warm biscuits in the remaining icing sugar and cool on a wire rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains tree nuts, gluten and milk. Per serving: 2 cookies. Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container.
